message.content:
The Clock app is now open, showing the main clock screen with the current time. At the bottom, there are tabs for Alarm, Clock, Timer, Stopwatch, and Bedtime. To create a timer, I need to switch to the Timer tab by tapping the "Timer" button at the bottom navigation bar.

The Timer tab button is located at coordinates [399,885,599,972] based on the tree structure description.
do(action="Tap", element=[399,885])
